name: on-page-seo-analyzer
description: On-page SEO analyzer with bounded public-page fetching and transparent scoring
author: Filip Konecny

scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:server && npm run test:coverage:browser
scripts.test:coverage:browser: c8 --all --include=public/**/*.mjs --per-file --check-coverage --lines 90 --functions 90 --branches 80 --reports-dir=coverage/browser --reporter=text --reporter=lcov node --test test/browser-analyzer-app.test.js test/browser-api-client.test.js test/browser-html-shell.test.js test/browser-report-renderer.test.js test/browser-utils.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage
